subcriteria.text: Category initialization persistently distinguishes first use from subsequent openings.
Reopening the category lookup does not duplicate initialized default records.
Reopening the category lookup does not recreate an initialized default category that a user deleted.
A mileage reading cannot be lower than an earlier reading for the same asset.
A mileage reading cannot be higher than a later reading for the same asset.
Mileage comparisons order same-day readings by Entry No.
Edits to mileage entries enforce the same earlier and later reading bounds and same-day entry ordering.
Converted status is set only by the Link Sales Order action after its required order/contact/date validation succeeds.
The selected order number and date snapshot are set only through the validated Link Sales Order action.
Converted status and order number/date snapshot fields are read-only to ordinary manual edits.
The Compliance Register list page displays Code, Description and Review Date.
The Compliance Register list page disables insertion.
The Compliance Register list page disables modification.
The Compliance Register list page disables deletion.

Normal trigger-running inserts enforce the complete variant eligibility rule: nonblank variants belong to the selected item, Blocked and Sales Blocked are false, and Purchasing Blocked does not affect eligibility.
Normal trigger-running modifications enforce the same complete variant eligibility rule as the picker and field validation.
Opening the variant picker without an item selected gives a select-item message.
Opening the variant picker without an item selected does not open an unfiltered variant lookup.
Blank Variant Code remains a valid selection even when the selected item has variants.
Numeric JSON copies values whose mathematical value is an integer anywhere in 1 through 10 inclusive are accepted.
Numeric strings are rejected as copies values.
Boolean copies values are rejected.
Fractional numeric copies values are rejected.
Numeric copies values outside 1 through 10 inclusive are rejected.
Hazardous items are emphasized on Item List using a standard attention or unfavorable style.
The hazardous-item emphasis is applied to an identifying Item List control.
Collection Review sorting places Critical before Follow Up.
Within the same Collection Review priority, overdue LCY amount is sorted descending.
For equal priority and overdue LCY amount, Collection Review sorts Customer No. ascending.
